title: Franco Fernandez · Automation & AI Engineer
description: Franco Fernandez, Buenos Aires. Automation & AI Engineer: AI agents, automations and custom software with Python, JavaScript, n8n and LLMs that work in production.

hero.h1: I automate processes and build software with AI that works in production.
hero.lead: I come from operations and digital transformation. Today I build AI agents, automations and custom software.

facts.t: daily interactions handled by one agent
years in operations and digital transformation

p: I started selling on marketplaces and social media, moved on to coordinating 18 people and auditing processes, and from there to automating them. That path left me with an edge: I know how work really gets done before writing a line of code.

Since 2020 I have worked in parallel as an IT freelancer: servers, VPNs, firewalls and custom Tienda Nube apps. That technical base let me move from running processes to building them: AI agents, workflows in n8n and Power Automate, and software in Python and JavaScript.

First I understand the process end to end; then I choose the tool (n8n, Power Automate, UiPath or custom code) and take it to production. I like to launch fast with what already exists and build custom only what is needed.
now: Developing automations and AI solutions at Softtek
Building my second brain with Obsidian, MCP and Claude
Studying Industrial Engineering and a SAP diploma at UADE
